dict.string: When you open an agent from Boop, Boop asks your terminal to show that agent's tab.
Boop talks to its body on your desk over Bluetooth.
While you hold Boop's button or use the mic button, Boop listens so it can react to what you say. Audio is never kept.
Boop turns what you say to it into text on this Mac. Only the words, never the audio, go to Boop's brain.
